title: annona neoulei
intro: Annona neoulei, commonly known as the Amazonian custard apple, is a plant species in the Annonaceae family native to South America. This plant has been reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Annona neoulei include its ability to act as a natural antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer agent, showcasing its potential in the development of new medicinal therapies. The bioactive constituents of Annona neoulei include annonaceous acetogenins, which are a class of compounds known for their potent biological activities and medicinal properties.
